---
title: "Model Selection: RWD vs STS"
format: html
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(ggplot2)
library(DT)

res <- readRDS(here("results", "model_fits.rds"))
```

## Section 1: AIC/AICc Table (from MARSS BFGS)

```{r}
#| label: aic-aicc-table
aic_aicc <- res$aic_aicc
aic_aicc$rwd_aic <- round(aic_aicc$rwd_aic, 1)
aic_aicc$sts_aic <- round(aic_aicc$sts_aic, 1)
aic_aicc$rwd_aicc <- round(aic_aicc$rwd_aicc, 1)
aic_aicc$sts_aicc <- round(aic_aicc$sts_aicc, 1)

# Identify states where RWD is favored
aic_smaller_for_rwd <- rownames(aic_aicc)[which(aic_aicc$rwd_aic < aic_aicc$sts_aic)]
aicc_smaller_for_rwd <- rownames(aic_aicc)[which(aic_aicc$rwd_aicc < aic_aicc$sts_aicc)]

# Add preferred model column
aic_aicc$preferred_aic <- ifelse(aic_aicc$rwd_aic < aic_aicc$sts_aic, "RWD", "STS")
aic_aicc$preferred_aicc <- ifelse(aic_aicc$rwd_aicc < aic_aicc$sts_aicc, "RWD", "STS")

DT::datatable(
  tibble::rownames_to_column(aic_aicc, "state"),
  caption = "AIC and AICc comparison: RWD vs STS (MARSS BFGS)",
  filter = "top",
  options = list(pageLength = 15)
)
```

## Section 2: AIC Comparison Bar Chart

```{r}
#| label: aic-bar-chart
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 6
aic <- aic_aicc[, 1:2]
aic <- tibble::rownames_to_column(aic, "state")
aic$diff <- aic$sts_aic - aic$rwd_aic

aic_long <- pivot_longer(aic, cols = c("rwd_aic", "sts_aic"), names_to = "model", values_to = "AIC")

ggplot(aic_long, aes(x = state, y = AIC, fill = model)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "dodge") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
  labs(title = "Comparison of AIC Values by State", x = "State", y = "AIC Value", fill = "Model")
```

## Section 3: AIC Difference Plot

```{r}
#| label: aic-diff-plot
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 6
ggplot(aic, aes(x = state, y = diff, fill = diff > 0)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "lightblue", "FALSE" = "darkblue"),
                    name = "Model Better",
                    labels = c("TRUE" = "RWD Better", "FALSE" = "STS Better")) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
  labs(x = "State", y = "AIC Difference")
```
